vibe.verdict: A neat election night banquet built on the bathroom and coffee-spill moments, but the Bureau's hats and doors barely appear.
missing: The bus on the 7:05 a.m. morning (David and Elise)
Coffee spilled on David's shirt, by 7:05 (Harry Mitchell)
Rain blocks the Bureau tracking (Harry and David)
The Chairman's plan going blank at the end
Elise's rehearsal with the ballet company
ideas: Swap the 'Hat check' ticket for a Bureau hat check with a door on the back.
Replace the plain 'Beer' line with 'Rain, on tap (no tracking)'.
Swap 'Soft drinks' note for 'Cola, ginger ale, club soda. Not the Chairman's choice'.
Add a blank page headed 'The Plan' at the foot of the cocktail list.
